title: 'Someone Already Built That' is the Favourite Excuse of Broke Developers
why_read: A generic motivational anecdote about building boring B2B software instead of trendy AI apps, offering business advice rather than technical content.
analysis: This post tells an illustrative (and likely fictionalized) story about a developer pivoting from an unsuccessful AI product to a simple, profitable niche business tool for a small company. The advice, that boring, unsexy problems for real paying customers often beat chasing trendy tech, is common startup wisdom repeated frequently in indie-hacker circles. There is no technical content here at all, it's purely a business-motivation piece dressed up as a story.
